[01 / Proposed intensive or short series]{.eyebrow}

### [Strategic Decision Workshop](/workshops/index.qmd#choice-cascade)
:::
::: {.offer-body}
For leadership teams with plans but unresolved decisions about where to compete, how to create an advantage and which capabilities to develop.

Connect the team’s strategic choices, clarify what it will exclude and identify the assumptions that need testing.

**Working output:** a one-page record of strategic choices and assumptions.
:::
:::

::: {.offer}
::: {.offer-label}
[02 / Applied learning lab]{.eyebrow}

### [Knowledge Sharing & Organisational Learning Lab](/workshops/index.qmd#knowledge-flows)
:::
::: {.offer-body}
For organisations that store knowledge but struggle to move expertise into changing work.

Map codified and tacit knowledge, relationships and opportunities to learn through practice.

**Working output:** an organisational learning and knowledge-flow blueprint.
:::
:::

::: {.offer}
::: {.offer-label}
[03 / Strategy prototyping studio]{.eyebrow}

### [Strategy Prototyping Studio](/workshops/index.qmd#blended-studio)
:::
::: {.offer-body}
For teams that need to explore beyond familiar assumptions and connect experimentation to a strategic choice.

Move between knowing, making and playing; challenge alternatives through scenarios and bounded tests.

**Working outputs:** alternative hypotheses, scenario prototypes and assumption tests.
:::
:::

::: {.offer}
::: {.offer-label}
[04 / Scoped to the decision]{.eyebrow}

### [Executive Offsites & Custom Masterclasses](/workshops/index.qmd#custom-offsites)
:::
::: {.offer-body}
Combine the modules around an executive decision, a capability question or a leadership team's need to work through competing assumptions.

Format, participants and intended outputs are agreed during scoping.

**Starting point:** a clear decision and the people who need to work on it.
:::
:::
